title: BJP MP Kangana Ranaut moves Delhi HC against AI generated, obscene content
source_used: Hindustan Times (full text read); pool item The Economic Times (page text was navigation only)
key_facts: Actor and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut, MP from Mandi, moved the Delhi High Court on Thursday 8 Oct 2026, seeking removal of AI-generated obscene content about her from the internet.
Her plea says the content maligns and defames her and infringes her personality rights.
Her lawyer objected to sexual and pornographic content, fake news, and AI-generated content that wrongly attributes statements to her.
Her legal team sought relief only against obscene and allegedly fake online content, not against memes or other satirical content about her.
Justice Vikas Mahajan of the Delhi High Court issued a summons to the defendant parties.
quote_evidence: The actor alleged that the content maligns and defames her and infringes on her personality rights.
Kangana's legal team emphasised that they were seeking relief only against the obscene and allegedly fake online content, and not against memes about her.
why_it_matters_hint: A public figure's legal route against AI-made fake content; the plea is an allegation and no ruling is reported.
notes: The Economic Times page text was navigation and ads only, so the story text came from the Hindustan Times page. The wire origin of the HT text is not stated in the text read. Chosen category LAW (court plea).
